gloss: to eat (vulgar); to receive (a blow); to suffer

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {喰|く}らっていませんでした

definitions.explanation: Vulgar or rough word for eating, often used in masculine speech or to describe eating voraciously.

definitions.gloss: to receive (a blow), to get hit
definitions.explanation: To take a punch, kick, or other physical strike.

definitions.gloss: to suffer, to be subjected to
definitions.explanation: To experience negative consequences such as defeat, punishment, or misfortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧いっぱい{喰|く}らった。
examples.english: I ate until I was stuffed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らう⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧だ。
examples.english: I live on a diet of eating meat every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}→牛丼：08600_gyuudon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三杯|さんばい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{喰|く}らったぞ。
examples.english: That guy devoured three bowls of beef bowl!

examples.japanese: ⟦パンチ→パンチ：11258_panchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らった。
⟦{顔面|がんめん}→顔面：14693_ganmen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦キック→キック：08940_kikku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らう。
examples.english: To take a kick to the face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強烈|きょうれつ}→強烈：15109_kyouretsu⟧なアッパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らって⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: I took a powerful uppercut from my opponent and fell down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大敗|たいはい}→大敗：08201_taihai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らった。
⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{喰|く}らわされた。
examples.english: I was victimized by a scam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{停学|ていがく}→停学：22314_teigaku⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らってしまった。
examples.english: I ended up getting hit with a one-week suspension.

notes:
{喰|く}らう is a rougher, more masculine variant of ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

REGISTER:
Senses 1 (eating) is vulgar or rough; senses 2-3 (receiving blows/suffering) are colloquial but widely used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦パンチ→パンチ：11258_panchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らう: to take a punch
- ⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧{喰|く}らう: to get hit once
- {大損|おおぞん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喰|く}らう: to suffer a big loss
- ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{喰|く}らう: to fall victim to fraud

CAUSATIVE FORM:
{喰|く}らわせる/⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used to mean 'to give someone (a blow)'.
